title: Umthuthukisi Omkhulu Wezinhlelo ze-Windows
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Indima

Umuntu ozophumelela uzoba nomthwalo wemfanelo wokwenza lokhu okulandelayo:

  • Ukuklama, ukuthuthukisa nokwenza kusebenze kangcono izingxenye zesistimu ye-Windows ezisezingeni eliphansi ze-Kyber
  • Ukuthuthukisa amasevisi e-Windows, izenzeli zesistimu nezishayeli (ezisemodini yomsebenzisi nasemodini yomnyombo, kuye ngesimo)
  • Ukusebenza ngqo nama-API omdabu e-Windows (Win32, NT Native API) nokuxhumana nomkhakha wonke we-Windows (Active Directory/Kerberos, njll.)
  • Ukuphenya nokuxazulula izinkinga eziyinkimbinkimbi ezihlobene nokusebenza, ukuphathwa kwememori, ukuvumelanisa kanye nokuphepha
  • Ukususa amaphutha ezingeni eliphezulu (ukuhlaziya amafayela okuwa kwesistimu, ukususa amaphutha emnyombweni, ukuhlaziya isitaki, kanye nobunjiniyela bokuhlehla ngezikhathi ezithile)
  • Ukubhala imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe ecacile nehlala isikhathi eside
  • Ukubamba iqhaza ezinqumweni zokwakheka kwesistimu ezingeni eliphansi nasekubuyekezweni kwekhodi okubalulekile
  • Ukuhlala ulandelela njalo intuthuko ekusebenzeni kwangaphakathi kwe-Windows nasemathuluzini asezingeni lesistimu.

Amakhono Obuchwepheshe Adingekayo

  • Ulwazi oluphambili ngokwakheka kwangaphakathi kwe-Windows nemikhakha yayo
  • Ukuqonda okujulile kwezindlela zokuvumelanisa, ukuphathwa kwememori nokuphathwa kwamaphutha ezingeni lesistimu + ukuqonda okucacile kwemingcele phakathi kwemodi yomsebenzisi nemodi yomnyombo, kanye nokuphathwa kwezikhathi zokungena zabasebenzisi
  • Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwamathuluzi e-Windows okususa amaphutha nokuhlaziya
  • Izilimi Zokuhlela: C / C++ / Rust / x86/x64
  • Amathuluzi Nendawo Yokusebenza: Visual Studio namathuluzi okwakha e-Windows, GitLab kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ngokubambisana

Ngawe

  • Iminyaka emi-5 kuya kwe-10 yokuhlangenwe nakho emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa isofthiwe, ugxile kakhulu ekuhleleni izinhlelo zesistimu ye-Windows
  • Umlando oqinisekisiwe wokusebenza ezinhlelweni eziyinkimbinkimbi ngokobuchwepheshe nezibalulekile kakhulu
  • Ikhono eliqinile lokucabanga ezingeni eliphansi nokuqonda izisekelo zekhodi ezinkulu esezikhona
  • Ukunemba okuphezulu, ukuzimela nokunaka imininingwane, kanye nentshisekelo enkulu yokuxazulula izinkinga zobuchwepheshe ezingelula
  • Ikhono lokwabelana ngobungcweti nokweluleka onjiniyela abasaqala

Amakhono Angaba Yinzuzo:

  • Ulwazi ngokuphepha kwesistimu noma ngokuqinisa izingxenye ze-Windows, isizinda sobunjiniyela bokuhlehla noma sokuhlaziya izinhlelo ezinonya, iminikelo kumaphrojekthi omthombo ovulekile asezingeni eliphansi noma agxile kwisistimu
  • Ulwazi lokusebenza ezimweni ezinemikhawulo (izinhlelo zesikhathi sangempela, ukutholakala okuphezulu, isofthiwe lapho ukuphepha kubaluleke kakhulu)

Inqubo Yenhlolokhono

  1. Ucingo Lokuqala Lwemizuzu eyi-15: Ingxoxo emfushane mayelana nogqozi lwakho, ukuthi uyafaneleka yini, nokuphendula imibuzo yakho engahlangene nobuchwepheshe.
  2. Izinhlolokhono Ezimbili Zobuchwepheshe/Zomkhiqizo Zehora Elilodwa Ngayinye: Ukuhlolisisa ngokujulile indlela oxazulula ngayo izinkinga, ne-CTO yethu kanye/noma umklami wethu oholayo wezixazululo
  3. Ukuhlangana Nethimba: Iseshini engahlelekile yokuqinisekisa ukuthi niyavumelana ngokwesiko lomsebenzi.

Esikunikezayo

  • Amaphrojekthi anobuchwepheshe obuphezulu nayinselele engqondweni
  • Indawo yokusebenza eyazisa ubungcweti bangempela bobunjiniyela futhi egxile kwezobuchwepheshe (ayikho imihlangano engenamsebenzi noma imibiko engadingeki)
  • Ukuzimela okukhulu ekuthatheni izinqumo zobuchwepheshe
